'''Super Meal''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

Super Meal may randomly appear in the [[Volcano Dungeon#Shop|Volcano Dungeon shop]], [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in the [[Stardrop Saloon|Stardrop Saloon's]] rotating stock. 5 Super Meals may occasionally be found in a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern. 1-2 Super Meals may occasionally be found in [[Supply Crate]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Beach Farm|Beach Farm]] provided the player has upgraded the [[Farmhouse]] exactly once. One Super Meal may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Tailoring==
Super Meal is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Green Flannel Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt255.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily|Emily's]] and [[Haley|Haley's]] house, at [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Super Meal is not used in any [[quests]].
